title: Package Script CWD Fix
requirements: Add `cd "$PROJECT_ROOT"` immediately after PROJECT_ROOT is computed in scripts/package.sh, before invoking xcodebuild
Verify xcodebuild -scheme DiaryTranscriber is invoked from the project root so it finds the .xcodeproj / workspace
Fail fast with a clear error message if PROJECT_ROOT does not exist after cd (e.g. set -e or explicit test in the script)
acceptance_criteria: Invoking the script from another directory (e.g. cd /tmp && /path/to/scripts/package.sh) succeeds and produces a signed .app
xcodebuild logs show the project root as the working directory
Script exits non-zero with a clear message if the project root cannot be reached
